content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-125. - Unlawful purposes.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any person to sell, give, furnish, deliver or otherwise transfer,
               or offer to sell, give, furnish, deliver or otherwise transfer to any person, any
               substance releasing toxic vapors, when such seller, giver, furnisher, deliverer, transferrer
    …

faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person to sell, give, furnish, deliver or otherwise transfer,
               or offer to sell, give, furnish, deliver or otherwise transfer to any person, any
               substance releasing toxic vapors, when such seller, giver, furnisher, deliverer, transferrer
               or offerer knows or has reason to believe that such substance will be used for purposes
               unlawful under
sections 62-122
—
62-125
.
(Code 1981, § 21-60; Ord. No. 738, § 3, 10-21-1968)
